ai_summary: AGI Infra Limited has announced a record date of September 23, 2026, for determining shareholders eligible for the final dividend for the financial year 2025-26, which is subject to approval at its 21st Annual General Meeting. The company's register of members will subsequently be closed from September 24 to September 30, 2026, to facilitate these corporate actions. This is a routine regulatory filing, signaling an upcoming dividend distribution and AGM, with no red flags identified regarding the company's operations or financials.
